comments.author: shayanblest
comments.text: Audit completed against AGENTS.md §7. Public API: Button, Badge, Dropdown, and ResizeObserver are intentionally exposed through secondary public-api.ts entry points; Theme and Locale are exported through the root public-api.ts. Build output includes the intended five entry points and CSS assets; package-path smoke automation remains covered by bulud-ng-mi5.4.4. Config precedence: Theme provides typed global-to-library resolution and components expose instance CSS-variable overrides, but the complete instance → component default → global → library chain is not uniformly proven by rendering tests; follow-ups bulud-ng-mi5.1.3 and component tasks bulud-ng-mi5.2.1, bulud-ng-mi5.2.2, and bulud-ng-mi5.2.3. The ResizeObserver enabled input is instance-only and its non-applicable config levels are documented and tested. The Locale provider resolves typed English/Persian defaults and instance dropdown text wins; broader locale coverage is tracked by bulud-ng-mi5.1.4. Theming: explicit light/dark theme.css and CSS custom-property hooks exist, but hardcoded theme fallbacks remain in component styles and theme override coverage is not exhaustive; track under bulud-ng-mi5.1.3 and bulud-ng-mi5.4.4. Accessibility: Button uses native button semantics and loading/disabled state; Badge has projected content and labeled dismiss action; Dropdown has combobox/listbox keyboard, focus, selection, loading/empty, invalid, forms, locale, and RTL behavior; ResizeObserver adds no semantics and documents consumer responsibility. Remaining demo/E2E gaps include exhaustive Badge sizes/states, Button visual state assertions, and Dropdown Forms/invalid/required assertions; track component tasks and bulud-ng-mi5.4.4. Forms: Dropdown implements ControlValueAccessor/Validator and has focused tests; Button and Badge are not form controls; ResizeObserver is not a form control. Unit coverage exists for all five surfaces, but precedence/rendering and package smoke gaps remain. No retained utility surface beyond ResizeObserver was found. Report status: audit in_progress; focused follow-up tasks linked above; no code changes made.

title: Accessible component catalog
description: Deliver the core and form-oriented Angular components needed by application teams, with complete accessible interaction patterns and forms behavior where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Each component has a standalone typed API, documented states, accessibility behavior, demo coverage, unit tests, and applicable E2E coverage.

title: Bulud NG library roadmap
description: Build a production-ready Angular UI library with accessible standalone components, typed pipes and directives, predictable configuration and theming, forms integration, localization, demos, documentation, and release validation.
acceptance_criteria: All planned foundation, component, utility, quality, documentation, and release tasks are complete or explicitly deferred; every shipped public surface has intentional exports, docs, unit coverage, demo coverage, and required E2E validation.

title: Add Playwright interaction and theme coverage
description: Cover public demo pages with real keyboard/pointer interaction, focus, ARIA state, RTL, light/dark, and computed-style instance theme override assertions.
acceptance_criteria: npm run e2e passes with one focused spec per demo surface and no snapshot-only accessibility claims.

title: Complete public API documentation
description: Document every public component, directive, pipe, provider, input, output, usage example, state, keyboard behavior, forms contract, and consumer accessibility responsibility.
acceptance_criteria: Root and secondary entry-point docs are complete and match generated public declarations.

title: Complete component demo state matrix
description: Make every supported component and utility state reachable from the demo, including variants, sizes, disabled, loading, invalid, empty, focus-visible, hover, RTL, light/dark, and instance overrides where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Demo pages cover every applicable declared state and provide stable selectors for E2E assertions.

title: Define shared utility API conventions
description: Document and test common conventions for pure pipes and focused directives: typed inputs/outputs, SSR safety, cleanup, nullish handling, naming, and secondary entry points.
acceptance_criteria: Each utility task follows one consistent API/documentation/test pattern with no hidden global side effects.

title: Add opt-in ClickOutside directive
description: Add a browser-safe directive that emits when pointer or focus interaction leaves the host, with configurable event behavior and cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Outside interaction is detected without duplicate events, inside interaction is ignored, SSR is safe, listeners clean up, API/docs/unit/demo coverage pass.

title: Add accessible Tabs component
description: Add composable tabs with typed active state, keyboard navigation, stable tab/panel IDs, disabled tabs, and orientation support if exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Tablist semantics and APG keys work, focus and selection are predictable, panels are associated correctly, and docs/demo/unit/E2E coverage pass.

title: Add composable Accordion component
description: Add projected accordion items with controlled single/multiple expansion, stable IDs, disabled items, and accessible heading/button/panel relationships.
acceptance_criteria: Enter/Space behavior, aria-expanded/controls, collapsed focus safety, dynamic item handling, RTL/theme, docs, demo, unit, and E2E coverage pass.

title: Add accessible Dialog component
description: Add a composable modal dialog with projected content, accessible labeling, escape/outside-close policy, focus trap, focus restoration, and cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Dialog follows the applicable APG pattern, supports keyboard and focus lifecycle, documents consumer setup, and passes theme/RTL/demo/unit/E2E validation.

title: Add accessible Checkbox form control
description: Add a native-checkbox-backed standalone control with checked, indeterminate, disabled, required, invalid, projected-label, and Angular Forms behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard and label activation toggle exactly once; CVA/Validator, touched state, required validation, disabled propagation, semantic labeling, theme, docs, demo, unit, and E2E coverage pass.

title: Add accessible Switch form control
description: Add a standalone switch control with typed checked/disabled inputs, projected content, accessible state, and Angular Forms integration.
acceptance_criteria: Native or APG-correct switch semantics, keyboard behavior, CVA/Validator, disabled/touched propagation, theme, docs, demo, unit, and E2E coverage pass.

title: Harden Button states and accessibility
description: Complete Button variant, size, disabled, loading, focus-visible, hover, theme, RTL, documentation, and interaction coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Typed standalone API, semantic button behavior, accessible disabled/busy state, theme overrides, demo states, unit tests, and required E2E checks pass.

title: Harden Badge semantics and dismiss behavior
description: Complete Badge variants, dismissible behavior, accessible naming, theme behavior, documentation, and test/demo coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Badge semantics and dismiss action are accessible; supported variants and states are reachable in the demo and covered by tests.

title: Integrate locale and RTL defaults
description: Define typed locale defaults and ancestor direction behavior for accessible labels, placeholders, messages, and component text while preserving instance overrides.
acceptance_criteria: English/Persian labels and RTL behavior are documented and tested; explicit instance text wins over global locale defaults.

title: Pipes and directives
description: Add focused pure pipes and browser-safe directives that solve recurring UI needs without unnecessary dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Each utility has a narrow typed API, lifecycle/SSR safety where applicable, unit tests, documentation, and a demo or documented non-visual usage path.

title: Add FileSize formatting pipe
description: Add a pure pipe that formats byte counts with explicit base/unit and invalid-input behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Bytes, zero, large values, precision, negative/invalid input, and localization expectations are documented and unit-tested.

title: Add Persian and English digit conversion pipes
description: Add pure typed pipes for converting numerals between Persian and English forms with predictable handling of mixed text and nullish values.
acceptance_criteria: Conversions are pure, locale-independent by explicit mode, preserve non-digit text, document nullish behavior, and pass unit/docs/demo coverage.

title: Add Unicode-aware Initials pipe
description: Add a pure pipe that derives stable initials from Unicode names and labels, including Persian text and whitespace edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Unicode graphemes and common name forms produce documented initials without throwing; unit/docs/demo coverage pass.

title: Add ResizeObserver directive
description: Add a typed directive for content-box size changes with initial notification, duplicate suppression, enabled state, SSR fallback, and lifecycle cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Typed width/height output, enable/disable reconnect, destroy cleanup, unavailable-browser behavior, docs, unit, demo, and E2E coverage pass.

title: Add TextareaAutosize directive
description: Add an opt-in directive that measures textarea content and adjusts height without polling or layout feedback loops.
acceptance_criteria: Resize responds to value/input changes, respects min/max constraints, cleans up safely, supports SSR, and has docs/unit/demo/E2E coverage.

title: Add controlled Pagination component
description: Add a typed pagination control with current page, page count, previous/next, boundary states, and accessible labels.
acceptance_criteria: Controlled updates, disabled boundaries, keyboard behavior, localization, RTL, theme, docs, demo, unit, and E2E coverage pass.
